subject.title: [Feature]: Auto-discovery of agent configurations from external workspaces

question: Should OpenClaw core support trusted external workspace agent-config discovery, or keep agent registration explicit and prioritize zero-restart explicit agent management?
rationale: The requested feature adds a new config surface, filesystem trust boundary, and live agent/session registration semantics, so automation cannot safely choose the permanent product and security contract.

options.title: Keep Explicit Registration
options.body: Continue using central config, $include, and agents.create/update/delete, then solve the remaining pain through hot explicit registration before adding glob discovery.

options.title: Design Trusted Discovery
options.body: Approve core discovery only after maintainers define trusted roots, glob bounds, realpath/symlink handling, validation, precedence, reload semantics, and security proof.

options.title: Move Scanning Outside Core
options.body: Keep workspace scanning as operator tooling or a ClawHub/plugin package unless a smaller missing core API is identified.

recommendation.title: Keep Explicit Registration
recommendation.body: Continue using central config, $include, and agents.create/update/delete, then solve the remaining pain through hot explicit registration before adding glob discovery.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent schema and resolver history makes this the best available owner for the config/security direction choice.
